map_title_ontalvilla: Where are we? · Ontalvilla de Almazán
sobre_page_sub: Two people, two destinations, one shared passion for making you feel at home wherever you are.
sobre_intro: We are Miguel and Laura, two independent owners who share the same philosophy: offering authentic, carefully maintained accommodation with the warmth of someone who truly loves where they live.
miguel_p1: Born and raised in Soria, I have spent my whole life in love with its endless plains, oak forests and the peace you can only find far from city noise. I inherited the family home in Ontalvilla de Almazán and decided to share it with travellers looking to truly disconnect.
miguel_p2: I love welcoming families and watching guests marvel at the starry sky at night. If you have any questions about the area, hiking trails or the best local restaurants, don't hesitate to get in touch.
laura_p1: I arrived in Benidorm over twenty years ago and never left. The Mediterranean gets into your soul. I have several apartments a few steps from the beach that I look after as if they were my own home.
laura_p2: I love helping travellers discover the authentic Benidorm: hidden coves, the local market, the beach bars where the locals eat.
valores_sub: Beyond accommodation, we offer an experience
val1_desc: We are real people. We respond quickly and solve any question before and during your stay.
val2_desc: Every property is maintained in detail. What you see in the photos is exactly what you find.
val3_desc: We live here. We know every corner and love sharing the best-kept secrets of the area.
